name: qa-harness-template
description: Portable, self-configuring, read-only QA harness for Claude Code: 36 skills, 6 agents, 8 hooks, 7 rules, a system-map reference, a bundled HTTP MCP server, an installer and validators.

install.user_level: python scripts/install.py --user --skill <name>   (skills only, into ~/.claude/skills; no hooks)
install.notes: Dependencies are resolved from each SKILL.md: Skill(x) references, Agent(x)/subagent_type references, and the 'requires' below. Existing PROJECT-PROFILE.md / settings.json / harness-config.json / .mcp.json are never overwritten; the new version is written next to them as *.new.

core.description: Always installed with any project-level install: the persona, the profile, the read-only hooks, the always-loaded rules, the references and the MCP template.

shared.qa-standards: Every QA skill and agent reads it; installed with any skill.

configure-project.summary: Detects the stack, fills PROJECT-PROFILE.md, writes .mcp.json + harness-config.json, rebinds tools, live-verifies.

qa-standards.summary: The shared standard: modes, scope lock, evidence ledger, mutation gate, completion gate, verdict contract, escape classes, memory ritual.

full-qa.summary: Master orchestrator: prompt → cases → code → DB → API → UI → security → perf → regression → audit → report → GO/NO-GO.

qa-validate.summary: Lighter cross-layer validation of one story/bug ending in ready / not-ready (GO / NO-GO).

qa-team.summary: Three parallel lanes (UI, API, DB) with one synthesized, audited report.

release-check.summary: Release-level sign-off across areas with the release checklist and an independent audit.

regression-runner.summary: Guards the indirect blast radius after a change.

prompt-generator.capability: always on (utility; register rows degrade per §2)
prompt-generator.summary: Step 0 of /full-qa: researches the request and writes one self-contained execution prompt (template + research map + /goal and /loop rules).

test-cases-generator.summary: Executable, traceable test plan with a code-derived denominator, input classes and expected-value sources.

pr-risk-analyzer.summary: Blast-radius risk map of a PR/diff before testing.

test-data-manager.summary: Locate / prepare / snapshot / restore test data under the Mutation Safety Gate; input-class fixture registry; provisioning pattern.

env-health.summary: Preflight: MCP servers, repos, portals, DB, auth, deployed build, release radar, prod sentinel.

sync-repos.summary: Pull every repo to the branch under test with read-only git verbs; report HEAD per repo.

login.summary: Authenticated session per role: browser, API token, or SSO impersonation.

code-review.summary: Code-level review incl. root-cause check for fix PRs and latent-pattern hints.

db-check.summary: Schema vs ORM drift, FK/orphans, soft-delete mechanism, tenant scoping, enum width, indexes.

api-test.summary: Auth, RBAC, validation, errors, schema, pagination, DB-write consistency.

browser-test.summary: Full user journeys with console/network capture and the path-exercised rule.

visual-regression.summary: Layout / overflow / responsive checks across breakpoints with measured evidence.

a11y-test.summary: Keyboard, ARIA, focus, contrast — scanner hits are leads, the Tab walk is the proof.

observability-check.summary: Errors the UI hides: console, failed/slow calls, 5xx, masked errors, silent async no-ops.

security-review.summary: 10-point audit mapped into the verdict contract; CSP/host allow-list method.

perf-test.summary: Page load / Web Vitals / API latency / query plans with measurement discipline.

ai-output-eval.summary: Recompute computed / model-generated outputs vs source rows; determinism; edge cases.

bug-verifier.summary: Confirms a suspected bug is real: CONFIRMED BUG / NOT A BUG / CANNOT CONFIRM / DUPLICATE.

bug-report.summary: Standard bug report with layer classification, evidence ledger, optional tracker filing per §15.

flaky-race-verifier.summary: Reproduction rate for intermittent bugs; race/timing hunt.

evidence-manager.summary: Captures, names and files evidence; assembles the ledger with provenance.

qa-report.summary: Renders the audited register/ledger into the 9-section report.

release-note.summary: Customer-facing release notes with a 'reported by' column.

explainer.summary: Plain-language, per-role before/after explanation of a change.

latent-pattern-sweep.summary: Crosses code assumptions (cardinality / branch / input class) against the live data distribution.

prod-sentinel.summary: Read-only production anomaly scan against a baseline (7 scan templates).

test-together.summary: Guided pair-testing in a shared browser with live expected values.

demo-creator.summary: Narrated, captioned MP4 demo of a real flow recorded with Playwright.

automation-writer.summary: Turns a confirmed manual case into a Playwright or HTTP test script.

superpowers.used_by: qa-standards → Plugins & escalation; every use has a by-hand equivalent

mattpocock-skills.used_by: grilling (ambiguous AC), diagnosing-bugs phases 1–4; every use has a by-hand equivalent

mcp servers.notes: GitHub and Jira are Claude Code connectors configured outside .mcp.json. Other engines (Postgres, Mongo) are added by /configure-project with approval.
